scope: Compact, versioned Godot-facing runtime package for the eight armored vehicles with structured technical profiles.
notes: The runtime package contains selected normalized or descriptive values, configuration IDs, claim references and indexed source URLs rather than complete canonical entities.
The eight entity IDs are an explicit allowlist and must also have an approved review status.
Derived metrics retain input claim references and are marked not_source_fact and not_game_balance.
ckb-lock.json records the bundle file hash, payload hash, schema version and exact entity order.
Canonical data remains authoritative; the runtime package is deterministic and rebuildable.
